name: A welcome beneath the necropolis
summary: Voltarus hangs above the blighted ravines of Zul’Drak, its towers and chains suspended over a landscape of ice and ruined stone. The greeting depends on the path by which the traveler arrives: those who aided Drakuru before are welcomed as familiar servants, while others receive a different introduction. Both versions lead into his account of the land. With Gorebag as guide, a broad tour reveals the scale of Zul’Drak and the reach Drakuru hopes to claim.
